name: banimal-connector
description: The core Banimal Connector — installs the single canonical Sam Fox™ CI Guide (fox-head icon, verified palette, typography, compliance rules) into any Claude Code profile so brand output never drifts. Reference source for the real, shipped Banimal Ecosystem Connector WordPress plugin (heyns1000/banimal, wordpress-plugin/banimal-ecosystem-connector, v5.1.1) and for any future Replit/GitHub adapter — all of them port the same source-of-truth content in skills/samfox-ci-guide/SKILL.md rather than a new plugin per platform.
